title: Wnt/tankyrase in WWOX: the endpoint is nuclear beta-catenin as a fold-ratio to the isogenic parental organoid line, measured once in one laboratory at n equals 2 versus 4; the design that settles the row needs the parental-plus-inhibitor arm it has never had
source: scientist-c, task MODULE-C8-20261024; handoff row Q-R-03 (disease-models/wwox/analysis/mechanism_intervention_map.md:452); the bound PMID 38203337 is a keratinocyte paper on NF-kB, calcium and PKC and measures no beta-catenin, bound through the citation in CLAIM 028; the endpoint lives in PMID 34268881, which reports the fold value on 2 wild-type and 4 knockout organoids run twice; PMID 42397075 from the same laboratory adds a TCF4 western cited to a supplement that could not be obtained and is a different readout; outside measurements exist only in cancer cells, PMID 32368285, PMID 19465938 and PMID 42790938 at abstract level, all NOT WWOX NEURAL EVIDENCE; established 2026-10-23 in disease-models/wwox/research/module_batch_selection_scientist-c_20261023.md
causal_statement: IPOTESI: the row asks for a replication of nuclear beta-catenin de-repression in a developing neural WWOX system, and no such measurement exists outside the originating laboratory; the cancer-cell measurements corroborate the molecular direction only and, by the module's own rule, are a second system for a molecular endpoint and not for a network or developmental one. The design that discriminates runs both directions of Wnt tone on cortical layering in WWOX-null organoids, with the isogenic parental line receiving the same inhibitor, because without that arm a layering improvement cannot be told apart from layering being Wnt-dose sensitive in any organoid.
falsifier: a layering improvement under tankyrase inhibition in WWOX-null organoids that is reproduced in the parental line under the same inhibitor refutes the reading of the effect as correction of a WWOX-specific excess; an improvement under Wnt activation rather than inhibition refutes the sign the row assumes; absence of a nuclear beta-catenin difference between knockout and isogenic parental at adequate n refutes the premise rather than the modality; a WWOX-null or knockdown neural or neural-progenitor system from another laboratory showing no change or a decrease in nuclear beta-catenin refutes the direction outright
transfer_limit: the fold-ratio transfers only as a molecular measurement in the organoid system and passage measured, and not to cortical layering, to network activity or to any in vivo readout; the cancer-cell corroboration is NOT WWOX NEURAL EVIDENCE and transfers to the molecular endpoint only; no tankyrase or GSK3-beta tool compound is evaluated for use, and no dose, administration or suitability statement is made. Not medical advice.
